{{Quote|I have had my weaknesses exploited. Now I will exploit yours.|Vinto Hreeda|<ref name="Vinto">{{SWIA|set=Jabba's Realm|cardname=Vinto Hreeda}}</ref>}}
'''Vinto Hreeda''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Rodian/Legends|Rodian]] [[Mercenary/Legends|mercenary]], [[Smuggler/Legends|smuggler]] and [[Gunslinger/Legends|boltslinger]] during the [[Imperial Era/Legends|reign]] of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]]. Hreeda was exceptionally skilled with a [[Blaster/Legends|blaster]] and few beings would stand a chance against him in a [[lightfight]].<ref name="ASAS" /> During his career, Hreeda obtained several scars that marked his face, but his most distinctive injury lost him his left [[Antenna/Legends|antenna]], leaving a large scar running the length of his face from his missing antenna, between the eyes, to his right cheek.<ref name="Vinto" />

==Personality and traits==
[[File:A_Heros_Welcome_IAJR.png|thumb|left|250px|Hreeda comes to the aid of his clan]]
{{Quote|I show the same mercy that has been shown to me.|Vinto Hreeda|<ref name="Vinto" />}}
After the Empire destroyed everything that Hreeda held dear, he honed his skills with a [[Blaster/Legends|blaster]] until he was more than a match for all but a select few in the galaxy. He hired his services out as a [[Mercenary/Legends|mercenary]], and relished any opportunity to strike back at the Empire he hated. His primary focus was to tear down the empire one stormtrooper at a time.<ref name="ASAS" /> He was seen as a protecting hero and vigilante to his home clan, and came to exact vengeance when a rival clan hired [[Pirate/Legends|pirates]] to raid medical supplies from his people.<ref name="AHW">{{SWIA|set=Jabba's Realm|mission=A Hero's Welcome}}</ref>

==Equipment==
[[File:Draw_-_Vinto_Hreeda_IAJR.png|thumb|right|180px|Hreeda was much faster on the draw than any stormtrooper.]]
{{Quote|My success at my craft grows out of the harsh consequences for failure.|Vinto Hreeda|<ref name="Vinto" />}}
Hreeda made use of dual [[DL-44 heavy blaster pistol/Legends|DL-44 heavy blaster pistols]] carried in dual [[Holster/Legends|holsters]] at his waist. He wore a brown, three-quarter-length coat with reinforced shoulders.<ref name="ASAS" />

==Behind the scenes==
The character of Vinto Hreeda was first introduced to the ''[[Star Wars]]'' universe in the "[[Jabba's Realm]]" expansion pack for the ''[[Star Wars: Imperial Assault]]'' strategy [[Board game/Legends|board game]].<ref name="JR">{{FantasyFlightGames|url=en/news/2016/8/5/jabbas-realm|text=Jabba's Realm: Announcing a New Expansion for Imperial Assault}}</ref>
